label: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt sandboxes
description: How The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mods live in Mods, one folder each.

Mods that add menu entries also need their .xml registering in bin/config/r4game/user_config_matrix/pc, and script mods usually need merging with the Script Merger. Neither is something a declarative rule can do — the files land correctly and the merge is still yours.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
